title: Identify all laboratory test records for patients who have abnormally high
question: Identify all laboratory test records for patients who have abnormally high uric acid levels (above the sex-specific upper normal limit), total cholesterol within the normal range, and at least one documented medical examination. For each such record, return the patient ID, sex, current age, the amount by which uric acid exceeds the normal threshold, and the number of distinct medical examinations the patient has undergone.

arguments.sql:
SELECT
    P."XCL_058" AS patient_id,
    P."XCL_059" AS sex,
    STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_060") AS current_age,
    L."XCL_022" - CASE WHEN P."XCL_059" = 'M' THEN 7.0 ELSE 6.0 END AS uric_acid_excess,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT E."XCL_001") FROM Examination AS E WHERE E."XCL_001" = P."XCL_058") AS examination_count
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
WHERE
    (
        (P."XCL_059" = 'M' AND L."XCL_022" > 7.0) OR
        (P."XCL_059" = 'F' AND L."XCL_022" > 6.0)
    )
    AND L."XCL_026" < 250
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM Examination AS E2 WHERE E2."XCL_001" = P."XCL_058"
    )

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
SELECT
    P."XCL_058" AS patient_id,
    P."XCL_059" AS sex,
    STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_060") AS current_age,
    L."XCL_022" - CASE WHEN P."XCL_059" = 'M' THEN 7.0 ELSE 6.0 END AS uric_acid_excess,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT E."XCL_001") FROM Examination AS E WHERE E."XCL_001" = P."XCL_058") AS examination_count
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
WHERE
    (
        (P."XCL_059" = 'M' AND L."XCL_022" > 7.0) OR
        (P."XCL_059" = 'F' AND L."XCL_022" > 6.0)
    )
    AND L."XCL_026" < 250
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM Examination AS E2 WHERE E2."XCL_001" = P."XCL_058"
    )
